description: Main application source code for Bluetooth LE central device using Zephyr RTOS, handling device discovery, connection, GATT service discovery, and temperature notification.

methods.name: scan_start
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth LE scanning with active scan parameters.

methods.name: notify_func
methods.description: Handles GATT notifications for temperature data.

methods.name: discover_func
methods.description: Handles GATT discovery process, including characteristics and descriptors.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Callback for successful Bluetooth connection, initiates GATT discovery.

methods.name: eir_found
methods.description: Processes advertising data to find target UUID and initiate connection.

methods.name: device_found
methods.description: Handles device discovery events during scanning.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Callback for Bluetooth disconnection, restarts scanning.
